summary: Scotiabank files Form 6-K incorporating by reference legal opinions for a dual-tranche senior medium-term note offering: US$1.1B 4.578% fixed-to-floating notes due 2029 and US$1.0B 4.904% fixed-to-floating notes due 2032, issued under an existing Distribution Agreement and Terms Agreement. The notes are issued under an indenture with Computershare trustees. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No special-situation mechanics, premiums, or activist elements appear. The filing merely registers the debt securities and supporting legal opinions.
